doc: url = "javascript:" + percent-encode("void (function(){\n" + source + "\n}).call(window);") with every byte outside A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~ encoded as %XX (UTF-8) and space as %20, never +. Source is 1 byte to 64 KiB (65536 bytes), valid UTF-8, no NUL, not blank, and not already a javascript: URL.
